CustomField.description: How multi-drawdown loans react when new drawdowns clear after schedule activation. Re-Amortise_Forward regenerates future schedule rows on each clearing; Bullet_Hold adjusts balance only; Manual notifies ops. Editable only via Loan_Amendment after schedule activation. Spec v7 Rule R19 / Part 5.2.1.3.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Re-Amortise_Forward: future schedule rows are superseded and regenerated on each drawdown. Bullet_Hold: outstanding balance grows; final period absorbs the increase. Manual: engine takes no action; ops handles via Manual Entry.
CustomField.label: Drawdown Reamortisation Mode
